verdict.rationale: Jev is API-first. The Playground's documented actions (paste state, add Noul/Choice/Score questions) map directly onto the API: the quickstart walks from Playground to the same call via SDKs, and every model is served by `POST /v1/systemone`. Model discovery is also available programmatically via `GET /v1/models`, with Python and JS SDKs that support async use, batching and retries. Missing for 10: evidence that console/account functions (API keys, usage, billing, settings) are exposed via API; a published OpenAPI spec (all probe paths 404); independent confirmation of UI-to-API parity.
